notes: The first route stops at شعبة: the text writes no names after him before «وأخبرني أحمد بن فضالة», which starts a second isnad that reaches the saying. The continuation of the first route is not written, so it is flagged for ruling.
«يحيى بن سعيد، ويزيد بن زريع، وخالد بن الحارث، قالوا» : three co-transmitters at one level.
